payload.title: Fence cancel on the claim token for consistency
payload.body: complete, release, update, and heartbeat all accept --claim and fence on it (reject a stale/foreign token); cancel is the only mutating git-native op without it. A foreign actor can cancel someone's claimed task. Add fenceCheck to the backend cancel() (no token → unfenced, as before) and a --claim option to the cancel CLI command, mirroring the complete/release/update pattern. Low-risk, non-breaking. Surfaced exposing the fencing token on complete/release/update.
